review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issues in the supplied source; only 2 MINOR UI/consistency issues and 1 NIT remain. Account authority checks hold: lookups use the composite vendor/account key, drafts are checked against the posted account, and sync and reconcile use the account stored on the draft row. The draft lock and revision/menu compare-and-swap block edits and deletes while a sync is running, and credential updates while a sync is running or uncertain only allow rotating secrets on the same channel. The remaining issues: the menu editor's React key can carry unsaved edits from one account to another; the connection test can mark newly saved, untested credentials as validated; and an unknown account in the URL silently opens the \"add new account\" form.","findings":[{"area":"UI wrong account","confidence":0.75,"issue":"The menu editor's React key ignores the account, so unsaved menu edits survive switching to another account that also has no draft.","severity":"MINOR","evidence":"page.tsx renders LineRichMenuStudio with key={draft?`${draft.id}:${draft.revision}`:\"new\"}, so two draftless accounts both get key \"new\" and useState(menu) is kept while the accountId prop changes.","file":"src/app/(app)/settings/line/page.tsx","impact":"An owner can save a menu typed for account A into account B's draft without realizing it.","recommended_fix":"Add the account ID to the key, e.g. key={`${account.id}:${draft?.id??\"new\"}:${draft?.revision??0}`}.","required_test":"Render with account A (no draft), edit the menu, switch to account B (no draft), and check that the editor resets to the template and the posted accountId is B."},{"area":"unsafe account updates","confidence":0.7,"issue":"The connection test can set lastValidatedAt on credentials that were rotated after it read the account.","severity":"MINOR","evidence":"testLineOfficialAccountAction decrypts and calls LINE with the old token, then updates lastValidatedAt by vendorId_id only; a save in between sets lastValidatedAt:null and new encrypted values that this update overwrites.","file":"src/app/actions/line-actions.ts","impact":"Settings can show freshly rotated, never-tested credentials as validated.","recommended_fix":"Use updateMany with a where clause that also matches the encrypted credential fields (or richMenuAccountVersion) that were read, and report connection_failed if count is 0.","required_test":"Use a fake fetch to run a save between the test's read and its write, then check that lastValidatedAt stays null."},{"area":"UI wrong account","confidence":0.55,"issue":"An unknown or deleted accountId in the URL silently opens the \"add new account\" form instead of an error.","severity":"NIT","evidence":"`query.accountId ? accounts.find(...) ?? null : accounts[0]` gives a null account, which renders the create form and selects \"new\" in the account picker.","file":"src/app/(app)/settings/line/page.tsx","impact":"An owner following a stale link may think they are updating an account but actually try to create a duplicate; the server's duplicate-channel check blocks it with a generic error.","recommended_fix":"Show a not-found message (or redirect to the default account) when a non-\"new\" accountId does not match any account.","required_test":"Request /settings/line?accountId=<foreign or deleted id> and check that no create form is shown and an account-not-found message appears."}]}
